cohort: The study included 636 participants from the WASH Benefits trial in rural Bangladesh, examining maternal biomarkers during pregnancy and their children's growth outcomes.
finding: Maternal immune status (AGP, cytokine sum score), hormones (estriol), and micronutrient status (RBP) during pregnancy were associated with child growth outcomes (WLZ, LAZ, IGF-1) at 3, 14, and 28 months of age.
